answer: Vesting time-lock: each agent's rewards vest over 60 days and any unvested balance is forfeited if peers flag it as a sybil. The operator pays by locking every reward stream, so each fake identity ties up capital for its own full vesting window, and running 50 fakes means 50 frozen streams at once. A seat's score climbs from nadir to zenith only through steady passing work, never by burst. Survives a ring that cashes out and quits: the ripple of one detected clone voids every sibling's unvested pay.
